text_block_list.text:
I decide to take a very tired Curren
Chan to the
infirmary to rest.

I'm gonna rest a bunch and recharge all
of my
cuteness. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Ruuumble...
Ungh... What's that sound?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Wait. Where am I?!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Eeeee! Currreeen!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: Gasp!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
...I can hear everyone's voices. They're
coming
down from the sky!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
And these clothes... this is what I wear at
my
winning concerts. And on my feet...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Ruuumble...

All systems online. Main engine ignited.
Ten
seconds to liftoff.
text_block_list.name: PA Announcement

text_block_list.text:
I'm finally going to outer space! All
right! ☆ Now I
can show the whole
galaxy how cute I am! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Three... Two... One...
text_block_list.name: PA Announcement

text_block_list.text: Lift off! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Hel-lo, outer space! The cutest girl in
the universe
has just arrived!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: ☆♪♯＄♪☆! Cute Каррен Тян!
text_block_list.name: Outer Space Curren Fan

text_block_list.text:
Wait, what? Was that... a dream? Wow...
A
dream...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. A concert in outer space. I wish I
could do
that for real! Haha! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Beep! Beep! Engine malfunction! Repeat. Engine malfunction!
text_block_list.name: PA Announcement

text_block_list.text:
Reaction control system failure. Please
evacuate
immediately.
text_block_list.name: PA Announcement

text_block_list.text:
What?! No! Hold on! I've gotta go meet
all my
fans in outer space!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're not gonna make it... Time to
blow up
now. ♪
text_block_list.name: PA Announcement

text_block_list.text: Haha! What a cute announcement!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: ...Wait, what?!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Huh? A dream?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Wow. My heart's still pounding.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Due to her nightmare, Каррен Тян
doesn't
manage to get enough rest.

Maybe it's because she had such a fun
dream, but
Каррен Тян seems to be
well rested.
